rationale: graph::render retains one drawn edge per stored reference, routes object references to a left boundary, and gives a lease an endpoint at its explicitly named supporting edge's junction. Labels and the complete accessible facts description are HTML-escaped, and the enclosing renderer retains escaped authored facts in the alternate pane. Tests count each reference kind, compare deterministic outputs, check quoted malicious labels, and distinguish edge junctions from object endpoints. Cycles and disconnected components are laid out deterministically rather than rejected as language errors. The layout follows first-discovered owning paths where available and does not infer a language ownership invariant.
